title: Tier Discount Schedule for Harborline Customer Accounts
content:
# Tier discount schedule

> Harborline Customer Accounts

The account tier sets the percentage discounts that each product's pricing rule applies, together with team, API, support and credit limits.

## Schedule of tier discounts (percent off)

| Tier | New domain registrations (registration price component) | Domain manual renewals and auto-renew charges (renewal price component) | Hosting plan term prices | SSL certificate subscription prices | Harborline Mail seat prices | VPS and dedicated server term prices | Website security plan prices |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Personal Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Harborline Business Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | 4 | 3 | 10 | 10 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | 7 | 5 | 15 | 15 | 8 | 7 | 15 |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | 10 | 8 | 20 | 20 | 10 | 10 | 20 |
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | 14 | 12 | 25 | 25 | 12 | 12 | 25 |

## Terms of application

1. A tier discount applies to the list or renewal price component of a charge only. It never applies to ICANN fees, domain restore fees, setup fees, proration lines, refunds or Microsoft 365 seats. The hosting discount is off hosting plan term prices, not setup fees or proration lines, and the email discount is off Harborline Mail seat prices, Microsoft 365 seats never being discounted.
2. When a product's own promotion or volume discount could also apply to the same price component, only the single higher percentage applies; percentages are never added or compounded.
3. Discounted components are rounded half up to the cent before fees are added.
4. Benefits follow the tier recorded on the account on the charge date.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

A domain renewal component of $37.40 on an account recorded as Harborline Reseller Gold on the charge date: 8 percent off gives $37.40 times 0.92, which is $34.408, rounded half up to $34.41. Any ICANN fee is then added in full, undiscounted.

If the same component also qualified for a 6 percent product promotion, only the single higher percentage, 8, applies to the component, once, giving the same $34.41.

## Points of judgement

- **Which tier's figures price a charge?** The tier recorded on the account on the charge date.
- **Does a tier discount reduce a restore fee?** No; domain restore fees are never discounted.
